_about: Investment prices, the same real price in every country (converted with params/fx.json), excl. VAT. A country file params/capex/<country>.json may override them.
battery_tiers_note: (kWh, price per kWh) sorted ascending, linear in between; flat 400 CHF/kWh (436 EUR/kWh) all-in for every size
pv_note: price per Wp of Voltiris modules: 1.80 CHF/Wp, 1.962 EUR/Wp
battery_replacement_note: over the PV life the battery is bought once in full, then (PV life / battery life - 1) more times at this share of the gross price (cells only; slab, enclosure and inverters reused), unsubsidised. With 25 and 10 years: 1 full + 1.5 x 60%, i.e. 25 years of battery
